text:
Priya (capacity): Quick heads-up — rolling out a small preview of L90e micro-pools in africa-east-1 (Nairobi) and sfo-edge-1. These are tiny, latency-first pools (4 x L90e per pool) intended for edge/near-edge inference workloads. Preview window: 2 weeks starting now. Self-serve path: Console -> Dedicated -> Micro-pools -> select "L90e-preview".

Priya (capacity): Important notes: 1) Pools are burstable preemptible (evictions possible during capacity pressure); 2) New fair-share allocation policy applied to micro-pools to prevent single-tenant saturation; 3) Pricing = base per-minute + burst premium; not eligible for Reserved Capacity commits in preview.

Priya (capacity): Quick command to list preview pools:```sh
redwoodctl pools list --region africa-east-1 --type l90e-preview
```

Luca (eng-runtime): How will KV cache behave across preemptions? Any warm-start plan?

Priya (capacity): Good q — graceful drains keep KV cache hot for up to 60s. If node is preempted we persist a lightweight checkpoint to S3 and use a quick-warm path on restart (expects ~250ms headroom for cold starts). We'll log metrics under dedicated.micro_pool.warm_start.* so eng-runtime can tune.

Marta (ops): Ops runbook + incident playbook? Can you drop the link and the rollback steps here?

Priya (capacity): Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated/l90e-micro-preview (ops steps, rollback, EVACUATE procedure). TL;DR rollback: 1) mark pool READ_ONLY via console, 2) drain in-flight requests using /drain endpoint, 3) reassign traces to fallback pool (e.g., l40x-std).

Sam (sales): Are we inviting customers or is this open to everyone on the account? Any quota bumps needed for Enterprise trials?

Priya (capacity): Preview is invite-first. AEs can request whitelist via the capacity form. If a customer wants Reserved afterwards, loop in your AE — we'll convert after telemetry and a brief qualification call.

deploy-bot: [infrastructure] created pool l90e-africaeast-001 -> status=ACTIVE, nodes=4, gpu=L90e, capacity_mode=burstable

deploy-bot: logs: {"pool_id":"l90e-africaeast-001","event":"provision_complete","ts":"2173456838"}

Theo (infra): Will this affect existing quotas or autoscaler settings in SFO? We should surface this in the capacity dashboard.

Priya (capacity): Good catch — I pushed dashboard updates and an alerts rule (dedicated.micro_pool.evictions.rate). Charts should populate in ~30m. Please watch p95 latency and evictions; if we see >2% evictions over 10m we'll pause new bookings.

Luca (eng-runtime): Can we add a canary routing tag so critical flows avoid micro-pools by default?

Priya (capacity): Yes — default routing will prefer standard dedicated pools; canary routing is opt-in via route tag `use_micro_l90e=true`. We'll add a short doc on tag usage.

Sam (sales): :raised_hands: thanks — passing to a couple EMEA trial accounts now.

Marta (ops): I'll run the smoke canary at 11:00 UTC and post results.

Priya (capacity): Thanks all — ping me or @oncall if you see regressions. We'll post a short summary at the end of the preview window with telemetry and next steps.
